content:
Reverse linkifiers were introduced in Zulip 12.0 a while ago, and I'm a big fan of them since I can just copy and paste e.g. PR URLs and still get an easy-to-read message.

In this server, they're not active for the most common kinds of linkifiers (e.g. #12345). Is there a specific reason for this? If not, I think it would be nice if more linkifiers were reversified.
I'd guess it just went unnoticed when this was added. I'd happily volunteer to add these to the linkifier settings.
I took a look and I guess it's the "convert" setting here? https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#organization/linkifier-settings
Should we just check all of those, or are there some we shouldn't convert?
Oh nice, I figured you'd have to add the regex explicitly.
Maybe you can get issue links to also linkify properly if you duplicate the normal linkifier? I suspect they won't work out of the box if you only set the checkbox
It also allows a custom template for the reverse direction, so I think this can be supported too. I'll take a look later this weekend.

Okay, I think I've added the most common of these, the majority of which are for the various GitHub repos. So just like you can write #44658 to link to either an issue or PR, if you paste a full link it'll get changed to the linkifier. If you really did want the full version for some reason, you can always ctrl + Z to undo the shortening.

Please ping here if I missed a linkifier you'd like reversed or you notice any problems. (I tried to be careful but copy pasting a couple dozen times was a bit tedious)
This also may not apply to moblie, or at least when I just tried on Android it didn't.
